# Stylish Entertainment

> Boutique wedding and event entertainment studio: professional DJs, live musicians, lighting design and venue styling. Based in Frome, Somerset; covering the South West UK-wide, plus London and the Home Counties.

Stylish Entertainment Ltd is a UK wedding and event production studio. Founded in the early 2000s and **resident DJ at Babington House (Somerset) since 2003**, the team has performed at hundreds of weddings, parties and corporate events across the South West, London, the Home Counties and beyond. The studio provides solo DJs, DJ + saxophone duos, full live trios (DJ + sax + percussion), production-grade lighting design and venue styling — all from one team, one quote.

- **Address:** 88 Weymouth Road, Frome, Somerset, BA11 1HJ, United Kingdom
- **Phone:** +44 7970 793177
- **Email:** via the contact form at https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/contact-us/
- **Typical wedding DJ price band:** £600 – £1,200 (depending on artist and lineup)
- **Core service area:** Somerset, Wiltshire, Devon, Dorset, Gloucestershire, Bath, Bristol, the Cotswolds. Also London, Surrey, Berkshire, Buckinghamshire, Hertfordshire, Essex, Kent.

## Service areas (location landing pages)

- [Wedding DJ South West](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/wedding-dj-south-west/): Premium wedding DJs across Somerset, Wiltshire, Devon, Dorset, Gloucestershire, Bath, Bristol and the Cotswolds. Hub page covering the home region.
- [Wedding DJ Somerset](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/wedding-dj-somerset/): Frome-based DJs covering the full county — Frome, Bruton, Wells, Glastonbury, Taunton, Shepton Mallet, Yeovil and the Mendips.
- [Wedding DJ Bath](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/wedding-dj-bath/): Boutique wedding DJ and live acts for Georgian Bath and the surrounding valleys (Bathampton, Combe Down, Keynsham, Bradford-on-Avon, Limpley Stoke).
- [Wedding DJ Bristol](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/wedding-dj-bristol/): Wedding DJs across Bristol — Clifton, the city centre, the Chew Valley and North Somerset.
- [Wedding DJ London & Home Counties](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/wedding-dj-london-home-counties/): London weddings plus Surrey, Berkshire, Buckinghamshire, Hertfordshire, Essex, Kent and West Sussex.
- [Luxury Wedding Entertainment South West](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/luxury-wedding-entertainment-south-west/): High-end production package — DJ, live musicians, lighting and styling for high-budget South West weddings.
- [Wedding Production London](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/wedding-production-london/): London-specific premium production for prestigious venues.

## Services

- [DJ Services](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/services/djs/): Wedding and event DJ services overview — solo DJs, DJ + sax, full trios, and bespoke set-building approach (no cheesy requests, no mic-shouting).
- [Wedding Lighting Design](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/weddings/wedding-lighting/): Lighting design specifically for weddings — fairy-light canopies, festoon installations, intelligent moving heads, dance-floor lighting.
- [Lighting Design (general)](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/services/lighting-design/): Lighting design for any event, including corporate and parties.
- [Venue Styling](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/services/venue-styling/): Decor and venue transformation — sashes, drapes, room layouts, before-and-after styling.
- [Kit Hire](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/services/kit-hire/): DJ equipment, sound system and band sound-kit hire for self-managed events.
- [Fire Pit Hire](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/services/fire-pit-hire/): Fire-pit hire for outdoor evening receptions.
- [Party Lighting](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/parties/party-lighting/): Lighting hire and design for private parties and birthdays.
- [Hire Shop](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/hire/): Self-service hire shop for individual lighting and event items.

## Venues — guides and information

Each guide is written from years of resident or repeat performance at that specific venue.

- [Babington House Wedding Info](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/venues/babington-house/): In-depth Babington House (Soho House, Frome, Somerset) wedding guide written by DJ Nige, resident DJ since 2003. Covers the Bar, Bar Terrace, Front of House, Orangery, Croquet Lawn, Walled Garden — including lighting recommendations (Light and Shade tree lighting, Chill Out Camp, Mini Chill Out Camp, Fairies in the Bushes) and expert tips on sofa removal, sound restrictions and venue flow.
- [Mells Barn Weddings](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/venues/mells-barn/): Wedding planning information for Mells Barn (Somerset) — a rustic listed barn venue with distinctive fairy-light ceiling installations.
- [North Cadbury Court](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/venues/north-cadbury-court/): Wedding info for North Cadbury Court (Somerset) — an exclusive-use country house.
- [Pennard House](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/venues/pennard-house/): Wedding info for Pennard House (Somerset) — a Georgian manor house wedding venue.
- [Kin House Wiltshire](https://www.stylishentertainment.co.uk/kin-house-wiltshire/): Wedding info for Kin House (Wiltshire), including the lit bar and exterior festoon setups.
